name: 跟进邮件
text:

name: 请假邮件
text:
主题：请假申请 [日期]

[称呼]：

因 [原因]，申请 [起止日期] 请假 [天数] 天。期间手头任务已交接给 [同事]，紧急事务可联系我。

请审批，谢谢！
[署名]
textEn:
Subject: Leave Request [Dates]

Dear [Name]:

Due to [Reason], I would like to request leave from [Start] to [End] ([Days] days). Tasks are handed over to [Colleague]; for urgent matters please contact me there.

Please approve. Thanks!
[Your name]
